display.purpose: Home h1 and section h2s, sentence case with trailing full stop.

display-page.purpose: Single h1 on Shop and Lab index pages.

numeral.purpose: Every price, count, corner tag and quantity; red when it carries value.

tag-input.purpose: Fields whose text is shown on the LED screen.

title.purpose: h3, card/tile names, FAQ questions, cart lines.

label.purpose: Field labels, legends, spec terms, crumbs, currency; muted.

shadows.name: device-glow
shadows.purpose: Light cast under the Runner Tag replica.

shadows.name: screen-glow
shadows.purpose: Light cast under the product-page LED screen.

shadows.name: dot-halo
shadows.purpose: Single 9px indicator LEDs (glow chips); feature bullets use 0 0 8px 1px.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing; for objects that travel.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Hover, selection and colour changes on controls are instant swaps.

motion.name: led-scroll
motion.purpose: LED scroll-left speed; freeze/flash 45ms ticks, 40-tick hold.

ledMatrix.ghostBed: mix(rgb(13,10,10), glow, 0.13) on canvas; --ghost on SVG; background --pit
ledMatrix.halo: radial: 55% alpha at 0.2 pitch, 16% at 0.45, 0 at 1 pitch
ledMatrix.font: ASC11 badge font, glyphs trimmed, 1-col gap, 3-col space
effects: animation presets: arrow, spinner, equalizer, bounce
ledMatrix.inverted: on red: lit = --void, ghost = rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 12px halftone

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; red fill, instant swap to orange on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:50px;padding:0 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:2px;background:var(--red, #ff2a1f);color:var(--void, #0b0909);font:700 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--orange, #ff7a1a)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange, #ff7a1a);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-primary:active{background:var(--ink, #f4eee9)}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; bordered, turns red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:50px;padding:0 24px;border:1px solid var(--line-2, #413334);border-radius:2px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #f4eee9);font:700 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--red, #ff2a1f);color:var(--red, #ff2a1f)}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange, #ff7a1a);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Tag Text Field
components.description: Pit well; text typed in Doto because it will show on the LED.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px}.ds-field span{font:600 .82rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted, #b3a7a0)}.ds-field input{min-height:50px;padding:0 14px;background:var(--pit, #060505);border:1px solid var(--line-2, #413334);border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink, #f4eee9);font:700 1.35rem 'Doto', 'Courier New', monospace;letter-spacing:.02em}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--muted, #b3a7a0)}.ds-field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--red, #ff2a1f);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--red, #ff2a1f)}

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Condensed caps; current/hover goes red with a dotted LED underline.
components.html: ShopDropsThe Lab
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:28px;background:var(--void, #0b0909);padding:0 16px;height:64px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #2c2223)}.ds-nav a{font:600 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;text-decoration:none;padding:8px 0;color:var(--ink, #f4eee9)}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--red, #ff2a1f);background:radial-gradient(circle,currentColor 1.4px,transparent 1.9px) 0 100%/6px 6px repeat-x}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange, #ff7a1a);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Glow Chip
components.description: Option chip with a lit indicator dot in the variant glow; fills with the glow when selected.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px}.ds-chip{position:relative;cursor:pointer}.ds-chip input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-chip span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line-2, #413334);border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink, #f4eee9);font:600 .95rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-chip span::before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--led);box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--led) 70%,transparent)}.ds-chip:hover span{border-color:var(--muted, #b3a7a0)}.ds-chip input:checked+span{background:var(--led);border-color:var(--led);color:var(--void, #0b0909)}.ds-chip input:checked+span::before{background:var(--void, #0b0909);box-shadow:none}.ds-chip input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--orange, #ff7a1a);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Square media on panel, Doto corner tag, red Doto price; 2px red inset outline on hover.
components.html: 6Samurai Strike GripKatana-style ripcord handle$21.24 CAD
components.css: .ds-card{display:grid;gap:4px;width:220px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink, #f4eee9)}.ds-card-media{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--panel, #141011);margin-bottom:10px}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-media,.ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card-media{outline:2px solid var(--red, #ff2a1f);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-tag{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;padding:3px 8px;background:var(--void, #0b0909);color:var(--red, #ff2a1f);font:900 .95rem 'Doto', 'Courier New', monospace}.ds-card-name{font:700 1.15rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-card-sub{color:var(--muted, #b3a7a0);font-size:.95rem}.ds-price{margin-top:6px;font:900 1.3rem 'Doto', 'Courier New', monospace;color:var(--red, #ff2a1f)}.ds-price small{font:600 .75rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted, #b3a7a0)}

components.name: LED Screen
components.description: 11-row dot matrix: ghost bed always visible, lit dots with halo, glow via --led.
components.css: .ds-screen{display:inline-block;padding:12px;background:var(--pit, #060505);border:1px solid var(--line-2, #413334);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -34px color-mix(in srgb,var(--led) 55%,transparent)}.ds-matrix{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(22,13px);grid-template-rows:repeat(11,13px);border-radius:4px;background:var(--pit, #060505) radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,#0d0a0a 87%,var(--led)) 4.6px,transparent 5px) 0 0/13px 13px}.ds-matrix .on{background:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,var(--led) 65%,#fff) 4.6px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--led) 30%,transparent) 5.5px,transparent 13px) 0 0/13px 13px}

components.name: DROP Band
components.description: Full-bleed red halftone band; LED lettering and controls invert to void.
components.css: .ds-drop{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:40px 24px;background:var(--red, #ff2a1f) radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,0,0,.13) 2px,transparent 2.6px) 0 0/12px 12px;color:var(--void, #0b0909)}.ds-drop strong{font:900 2.2rem 'Doto', 'Courier New', monospace}.ds-drop-btn{min-height:50px;padding:0 24px;border:0;border-radius:2px;background:var(--void, #0b0909);color:var(--red, #ff2a1f);font:700 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;cursor:pointer}.ds-drop-btn:hover{color:var(--orange, #ff7a1a)}.ds-drop-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--void, #0b0909);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The storefront is R3D's own LED screen, scaled up. Every surface is a matte, near-black enclosure; anything that matters (a headline, a price, a count, a drop) is spoken in lit dots or in the dot-matrix face that imitates them. The ghost bed of unlit dots is always visible behind the lit ones, so the screen reads as hardware, not as a font effect. The same 11-row matrix drives the full-bleed hero sign, the Runner Tag previews and the badge-font lettering in the header, so product and site share one pixel model.

Controls are the instrument panel around the sign: condensed uppercase labels, near-square 2px corners, 1px rules, no decoration. Colour is scarce by design. Red and orange behave like light: they appear where something is lit, live or actionable, and the rest of the page stays in warm charcoal.

Density is shop-grade: four-up grids, tight 12px tile gaps, sticky filter bar, but generous section breathing (56–104px) between the "worlds" of Beyblade X and Marathon.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black warm ground; red LED primary, orange LED secondary; everything else neutral.
11-row dot matrix as the signature surface, drawn by one shared pixel model (canvas live, SVG static).
Doto (dot-matrix) for headlines and every numeral; Barlow Semi Condensed caps for controls and labels; Barlow for reading.
Flat, rule-divided layout; the only shadows are light cast by LEDs.
State changes on controls are instant swaps; only physical objects (drawer, toast, photo) move.

rules.name: The Lit Signal Rule
rules.body: Red and orange mean *lit*: actionable, live, priced, counted or selected. Neutral content never goes red at rest; a screen with no lit elements is correct.

rules.name: The Scoped Glow Rule
rules.body: Any colour other than red/orange must arrive through `--led` on the element it belongs to; never hard-code a product glow into shared CSS.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Lit Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that carries value (price, count, quantity, stat) is Doto 900; prices and counts are red. Never set a price in Barlow.

rules.name: The Caps Are Controls Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text is reserved for things you operate or scan (buttons, nav, labels, names). Headlines are never uppercase; reading copy is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Only Light Casts Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow must be light from a lit LED, tinted `--led`. No neutral drop shadows, no elevation on cards, buttons or panels.

rules.name: The Hardware Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius above 2px means "this is a physical object"; never round a UI control to look like one.

dos: Do put every headline, price, count and stat in Doto 900, with value numerals in LED Red.
Do draw LED lettering with the shared pixel model (11 rows, ghost bed always visible, badge font); use SVG for static marks and canvas for anything that moves.
Do tint glows, indicator dots and screen light through the scoped `--led` variable.
Do keep controls near-square (2px), uppercase condensed and tracked, with 1px borders.
Do keep hover and selection as instant swaps; reserve easing for things that physically travel.
Do use a 2px orange outline for focus everywhere (void on red surfaces).
Do give every animated panel a meaningful resting frame for reduced motion and no-JS.
donts: Don't set type in red or orange unless it is lit (actionable, priced, counted, selected, live).
Don't add neutral drop shadows or lift cards on hover; depth is tone and 1px rules, and only LED light casts shadow.
Don't round controls, cards or media beyond 2px; larger radii belong to hardware replicas only.
Don't hide the ghost bed or render lit dots without their unlit neighbours; bare glowing text is not this world.
Don't uppercase headlines or body copy.
Don't hard-code runner glow colours into shared styles.
